at 2026-07-15T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix settings- --board-name 'Primary board'
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: settings-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec card --json board create 'Secondary board'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-create.json
exec card --json board use board_11111111111111111111
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-create.json

# The selected board accepts individual name and description changes.
exec card --json board edit --name 'Secondary renamed'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-renamed.json
exec card --json board edit --description '# Secondary context'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-described.json
stdin stdin-description.md
exec card --json board edit --description -
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-stdin.json

# One invocation changes both settings and repeating it is a no-op.
exec card --json board edit --name 'Secondary delivery' --description '# Delivery context'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-delivery.json
exec card --json dump no-op-check
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/initial-dump.json
exec card --json board edit --name 'Secondary delivery' --description '# Delivery context'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-delivery.json
exec card --json dump no-op-check
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/unchanged-dump.json

# Invalid combined input does not apply the otherwise-valid description.
! exec card --json board edit --name ' ' --description '# Must not persist'
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/invalid-name.txt
exec card --json board show
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-delivery.json

# Clearing removes only the selected board's description.
exec card --json board edit --clear-description
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-cleared.json

# An explicit board edit does not change the checkout selection or another board.
exec card --json board edit board_00000000000000000000 --name 'Primary renamed' --description '# Primary context'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/primary-edited.json
exec card --json board show board_00000000000000000000
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/primary-edited.json
exec card --json board show
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-cleared.json
